Controlled outage responses are browser-local test simulations.

two_client_regression_scope: Two browser tests use locally signed synthetic fixtures and intercepted responses to exercise state transitions and provider failure. They are regression tests, not chain proof.
trust_regression_scope: Six root/trust browser checks include one actual live root-read/reload/mobile case and five controlled storage, lock and queued-snapshot failures. Four additional two-client journal checks use signed synthetic fixtures and intercepted responses, including two-tab concurrency and a withdrawal initially missing its target. They are not additional chain transactions.
mobile_regression_scope: Two browser regressions check zero idle admission requests on static mobile views and refusal when the historical verification worker is unavailable. Lighthouse timing measurements are reported separately in mobile-performance.json.
navigation_regression_scope: Four additional browser checks cover graph-profile sharing/reload/Back, keyboard skip/focus and shareable views, mobile selected context to the matching AI example, and historical withdrawal proof versus fresh reads. They use the deployed UI and read-only hosted data.
